PowerShell(Get-Process node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Id, @{N='CPU\(s\)';E={[math]::Round\($_.CPU,1\)}}, @{N='Mem\(MB\)';E={[math]::Round\($_.WorkingSet/1MB\)}}, StartTime | Sort-Object StartTime | Format-Table -AutoSize)

PowerShell(Get-Process node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; $remaining = Get-Process node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($remaining\) { "STILL RUNNING: $\($remaining.Id -join ', '\)" } else { "All node processes stopped" })

PowerShell($p = Get-Process node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($p\) { $p | Select-Object Id,@{N='CPU';E={[math]::Round\($_.CPU,1\)}},@{N='Mem\(MB\)';E={[math]::Round\($_.WorkingSet/1MB\)}},StartTime | Format-Table -AutoSize } else { "NO node processes" }; "--- out/ ---"; if \(Test-Path "d:\\newmytime2cloud\\frontend-new\\out"\) { \(Get-ChildItem "d:\\newmytime2cloud\\frontend-new\\out"\).Count } else { "no out dir" }; "--- .next ---"; if \(Test-Path "d:\\newmytime2cloud\\frontend-new\\.next"\) { "has .next, BUILD_ID: " + \(Get-Content "d:\\newmytime2cloud\\frontend-new\\.next\\BUILD_ID" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\) } else { "no .next" })

PowerShell($p = Get-Process node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($p\) { $p | Select-Object Id,@{N='CPU';E={[math]::Round\($_.CPU,1\)}},@{N='Mem\(MB\)';E={[math]::Round\($_.WorkingSet/1MB\)}} | Format-Table -AutoSize } else { "NO node" }; "out exists: " + \(Test-Path 'd:\\newmytime2cloud\\frontend-new\\out'\); "next exists: " + \(Test-Path 'd:\\newmytime2cloud\\frontend-new\\.next'\))
PowerShell(Get-Process node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force; Start-Sleep 2; "killed: " + \(-not \(Get-Process node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\)\))

PowerShell(1..2 | ForEach-Object { $p = Get-Process node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.WorkingSet -gt 200MB } | Select-Object -First 1; if \($p\) { "sample $_`: CPU=$\([math]::Round\($p.CPU,1\)\)s Mem=$\([math]::Round\($p.WorkingSet/1MB\)\)MB" } else { "sample $_`: no heavy node proc" }; Start-Sleep 20 })

PowerShell(function TotalNodeCpu { \(Get-Process node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object -Property CPU -Sum\).Sum }; $a = TotalNodeCpu; Start-Sleep 25; $b = TotalNodeCpu; "total CPU start=$\([math]::Round\($a,1\)\)s  end=$\([math]::Round\($b,1\)\)s  delta=$\([math]::Round\($b-$a,1\)\)s"; "proc count: " + \(Get-Process node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\).Count)

PowerShell($out = "d:\\newmytime2cloud\\frontend-new\\out"; "out exists: " + \(Test-Path $out\); "top-level entries: " + \(Get-ChildItem $out -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\).Count; "index.html: " + \(Test-Path "$out\\index.html"\); "device page: " + \(Test-Path "$out\\device\\index.html"\); "out last write: " + \(Get-Item $out\).LastWriteTime; "newest file in out: " + \(Get-ChildItem $out -Recurse -File | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Desc | Select-Object -First 1\).LastWriteTime; "node still running: " + [bool]\(Get-Process node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\))

PowerShell("--- ssh available? ---"; \(Get-Command ssh -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\).Source; \(Get-Command scp -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\).Source; \(Get-Command rsync -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\).Source; \(Get-Command pscp -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\).Source; \(Get-Command plink -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\).Source; "--- ssh config ---"; if \(Test-Path "$env:USERPROFILE\\.ssh\\config"\) { Get-Content "$env:USERPROFILE\\.ssh\\config" } else { "no ssh config" }; "--- known_hosts hosts ---"; if \(Test-Path "$env:USERPROFILE\\.ssh\\known_hosts"\) { \(Get-Content "$env:USERPROFILE\\.ssh\\known_hosts" | ForEach-Object { \($_ -split ' '\)[0] }\) -join "`n" } else { "no known_hosts" }; "--- keys ---"; Get-ChildItem "$env:USERPROFILE\\.ssh\\" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Name; "--- is path local? ---"; Test-Path "/var/www/v2.mytime2cloud.com")
